theme.title: Mamba numbers
theme.subtitle: Kobe Bryant, 1996–2016
theme.recap: Kobe Bryant scored 81 in a night, 62 in three quarters and 40 or more nine games running.

questions.prompt: How many points did Kobe Bryant score against Toronto on January 22, 2006?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 22, 2006, Bryant scored a career-high 81 points

questions.prompt: On January 7, 2003, Kobe Bryant set the NBA record for threes in a game. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant also set an NBA record for three-pointers in a game on January 7, 2003, when he made 12

questions.prompt: In February 2003, Kobe Bryant scored 40 or more in how many consecutive games?
questions.note: Nine straight, averaging 40.6 for the month.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posting 40 or more points in nine consecutive games while averaging 40.6 in the entire month of February

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant sat out the fourth quarter against Dallas on December 20, 2005. How many points did he have through three?
questions.note: 62, one more than the whole Mavericks team had at that point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On December 20, 2005, Bryant scored 62 points in three quarters against the Dallas Mavericks

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant made just six field goals in Game 7 of the 2010 Finals. How many did he attempt?
questions.note: 6 for 24, though his 23 points led all scorers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant, despite shooting 6 for 24 (25%) from the field, scored 10 of his game-high 23 points in the fourth quarter.
